title: REQ · Approval gate and worktree cleanup tests are correct and green
summary: TestRunCleanup uses AutoPublish true and worktree failure and cleanup paths are covered
description: Context: with AutoPublish false run returns AWAITING_APPROVAL and keeps the worktree, so TestRunCleanup (Config{}) fails expecting a removal. Desired behavior: the cleanup test sets AutoPublish true; failure of Worktrees.Create stops the run before the agent; an agent failure removes the worktree without publishing. Why: the suite must be green and cover the gate and cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Given AutoPublish true and a succeeding agent, When Run is called, Then the worktree is created and removed once and the lock file is gone
Given Worktrees.Create fails, When Run is called, Then the error wraps it, the agent never ran and the stored status is RUNNING
Given the agent fails, When Run is called, Then the worktree is removed once and the publisher is not called
technical_constraints: Gate behavior in runner.go stays as is
